comparison.objective: Candidate removes a hot-swap fan; record releases a camera and attached plate from a cam-clamped mount.
comparison.physical_skill: Directional bracket depression maintained during vertical guide withdrawal versus cam-lever unclamping and removal of a mounted assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Fan placed while cage/neighbors remain seated versus camera-plus-plate upright on a pad, camera still attached, released, and not dropped.
comparison.reason: Both are release-before-removal tasks, but the record tests cam-clamp actuation and plate-mounted assembly handling rather than simultaneous bimanual latch holding in a crowded bay.
